content.user_title: Design Status UI with Apple HIG
content.value_statement: Status and progress UI can confuse users when duration, platform behavior, or activity data are unclear. This skill applies Apple HIG guidance to choose progress indicators, status bars, and activity rings.
actual_capabilities: Recommends determinate or indeterminate progress indicators based on task duration.
Explains placement, motion, labels, and cancellation guidance for progress states.
Summarizes iOS and iPadOS status bar visibility, contrast, and safe area guidance.
Defines when Activity rings are appropriate and how their colors and margins should remain consistent.
Points to Apple platform APIs such as ProgressView, UIProgressView, UIStatusBarStyle, and HKActivityRingView.
limitations: It is guidance content only and does not inspect or modify application code by itself.
It does not replace current Apple documentation for platform changes after the source material.
It focuses on status components and does not cover unrelated Apple HIG components.
Implementation still requires testing with real devices, accessibility tools, and target OS versions.

use_cases.title: Select the right progress indicator
use_cases.description: A product designer can decide whether a loading state needs a determinate bar, circular indicator, or spinner.

use_cases.title: Review status bar behavior
use_cases.description: An iOS engineer can check safe area, readability, and visibility choices before implementing full-screen or scroll-edge screens.

use_cases.title: Validate Activity ring usage
use_cases.description: A health product manager can confirm when Activity rings fit a feature and when another visualization is required.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Progress Indicator
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hig-components-status skill. My task takes [duration], progress is [known or unknown], and platform is [platform]. Recommend the status component and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Loading State
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a loading state for [feature]. Check indicator type, placement, wording, cancellation, and accessibility concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Design Status Bar Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply Apple HIG status bar guidance to [screen]. Consider full-screen media, scroll effects, contrast, safe areas, and restore behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Activity Rings and Custom Rings
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to decide whether [fitness feature] should show Activity rings or a custom progress visualization. Include platform support and misuse risks.

output_examples.input: A file export on macOS usually completes in two minutes and reports percentage progress.
output_examples.output: Use a determinate progress bar near the export area. Show accurate progress, keep the bar moving, and offer Cancel or Pause only when safe.

output_examples.input: A photo viewer hides all chrome during full-screen browsing.
output_examples.output: Temporarily hide the status bar only for immersion. Provide a simple gesture to restore it, and preserve safe areas when controls return.

output_examples.input: A meditation app wants colorful rings for daily breathing goals.
output_examples.output: Do not use Apple Activity rings for unrelated data. Use a distinct ring style with labels so users do not confuse it with Move, Exercise, and Stand.

best_practices: Prefer determinate progress when the app can calculate duration or percentage.
Place progress feedback where the related content will appear.
Keep Activity rings limited to Move, Exercise, and Stand progress.
anti_patterns: Using a spinner for long tasks when measurable progress is available.
Permanently hiding the status bar to create a cleaner visual layout.
Repurposing Activity rings for branding, decoration, or nonfitness metrics.

faq.question: Which status components does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers progress indicators, status bars, and Activity rings from Apple Human Interface Guidelines.

faq.question: Can it write SwiftUI or UIKit code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation choices, but it is not a code generator by itself.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use a determinate progress indicator?
faq.answer: Use it when duration or percentage can be measured, such as downloads, uploads, or conversions.

faq.question: When should the status bar be hidden?
faq.answer: Hide it temporarily for immersive contexts such as full-screen media, then make restoration easy.

faq.question: Can Activity rings show custom goals?
faq.answer: No. Activity rings should represent Move, Exercise, and Stand information only.
